SELECT * FROM todos WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND completed = #{completed} ORDER BY deadline DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (user_id, title, description, category, deadline, completed, remind_enabled, remind_time, priority, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{deadline}, #{completed}, #{remindEnabled}, #{remindTime}, #{priority}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET completed = #{completed}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND completed = true

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN completed = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed FROM todos WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date DESC
